title: Haddock with courgettes and white beans

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is a whole food or plain staple, including tinned beans and stock, which the brief allows.

supermarket.reason: Haddock fillets, courgettes, cherry tomatoes, tinned cannellini beans and basil are all everyday Tesco lines at normal prices.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a wide lidded pan and a knife, and frying, simmering and steaming fish on top are beginner techniques.

works.reason: The amounts suit a lunch for four, 150ml stock with the tomatoes gives a loose bean base, and 8 to 10 minutes covered will cook the fillets through.

honest_times.reason: Dicing three courgettes, slicing garlic, halving tomatoes and zesting a lemon fits 15 minutes, and the 6, 5 and 10 minute stages match the 20 minute cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A light pan of courgettes, tomatoes and basil suits a midsummer lunch, and the three courgettes form a main part of the dish rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short and clear, in plain British English, with no restaurant language or preaching.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, two tins of beans and plenty of vegetables make a filling, balanced meal a family would happily eat again.
